[[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]] | prevseason = [[2021–22 Liga FPD|2021–22]] | nextseason = [[2023–24 Liga FPD|2023–24]] }} The '''2022–23 Liga FPD''' was the 102nd season since of the [[Liga FPD]], the highest tier of [[football in Costa Rica]]. The season was divided into two halves: the Apertura, which was played from 17 July 2022 to 5 November 2022, and the Clausura, which was played from 14 January 2023 to 28 May 2023. [[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]] won the 2022 Apertura, while [[L.D. Alajuelense|Alajuelense]] won the 2023 Clausura. The regular season began on 14 January and concluded on 7 May 2023. The playoffs began on 14 May and concluded on 28 May 2023. Alajuelense won the Clausura tournament. === Table === === Final phase – Clausura 2023 === == Grand Final == The grand final was played between the Apertura and Clausura champion to determine the overall champion of the 2022–23 season.
